item.title: Brew 0.6.1
item.description:
Brew 0.6.1

  • Brew's panel in Premiere: pick a ready short or a beat, Make the cut, and the short lands in your timeline.
  • Brew asks for your invite code the first time it opens, next to your Claude key.
  • Brew updates itself: Check for Updates in the Brew menu, and a check once a day on its own.
  • Brew no longer writes inside its own app, so macOS keeps trusting it after you use it.
